calculate_matches: calculate answer matches across retrieved documents using multiprocessing for a QA dataset
has_answer: check if a document text contains any of the provided answer strings using tokenization
f1_score: compute the maximum F1 score between a prediction and multiple ground truth answers
exact_match_score: compute the maximum exact match score between a prediction and multiple ground truth answers
SimpleTokenizer_tokenize: tokenize text into alphanumeric and non-whitespace tokens with optional lowercasing
